title: agent_search input
description: Search listed capabilities. Returns public projections and match reasons, never endpoints. A service you used carries your record with it; with a need_key, earlier choices for that need are kept in view.

need_key.description: The need this search is for, as the caller keys its sourcing decisions (sourcing_record). With it, the providers the caller chose for that need before and that this search doesn't return come back under previously_used.
